title: Serengeti vs Masai Mara: How They Compare
excerpt: The Serengeti and the Masai Mara are one ecosystem, divided by a border. How do they compare for wildlife, crowds and travel?
body:
The Serengeti in Tanzania and the Masai Mara in Kenya are part of the same ecosystem. The wildebeest do not know a border, but for travellers the two parks feel quite different.

## Size

The Serengeti is much larger, around 14,750 km². The Masai Mara reserve is around 1,500 km², with private conservancies around it.

## The migration

The herds spend most of the year in the Serengeti. They are in the Masai Mara roughly from August to October. River crossings happen on both sides of the Mara River.

## Crowds

Because the Mara is smaller, popular sightings can attract many vehicles in high season. The Serengeti has more space, especially in the north and west. Private conservancies in Kenya limit vehicle numbers.

## Travel

The Mara is a short flight from Nairobi. The Serengeti combines easily with Ngorongoro, Tarangire, Kilimanjaro and Zanzibar.

## Which one?

- Choose the Serengeti for space, variety and a full Tanzania trip.
- Choose the Mara for a short safari from Nairobi.
- Or combine both: see [Tanzania and Kenya in one trip](/blog/tanzania-and-kenya-combined/).

See also [Tanzania or Kenya](/blog/tanzania-or-kenya/) and [plan your safari](/travel-proposal/).
